name: FICN (Fake Indian Currency Notes) Network
description: Systematic production and distribution of high-quality counterfeit Indian currency, operated as joint venture between ISI (strategic direction, technical expertise) and D-Company (production, distribution networks). Designed to undermine Indian monetary stability, fund operations without traceable financial flows, and create economic chaos.

origins.earliest_operations: Early 1990s — following 1993 Bombay bombings establishes D-Company capability for large-scale operations
origins.quality_breakthrough: Post-2000 — acquisition of high-grade printing technology (North Korean and European sources suspected)
origins.scale_estimates: Annual injection of ₹100-300 crore of FICN into Indian economy at peak (2005-2016)

production.quality: Grade A — passes standard bank verification; requires specialized detection

primary_channels: Khanani network — global hawala for FICN placement
D-Company India cells — smuggling across western borders
Nepal route — porous border, shared cultural space
distribution.placement_strategy: Mix with genuine currency at 10-15% ratio to avoid immediate detection; circulate through rural/semi-urban markets first

strategic_purpose.economic_warfare: Inflationary pressure, monetary trust erosion, transaction friction costs
strategic_purpose.operational_finance: Terror operations funded without electronic traceability; cash-only jihad logistics
strategic_purpose.intelligence_cover: Payments to assets untraceable; deniable sponsorship

key_operators.dawood_ibrahim: Strategic oversight, production facility protection via ISI cover
key_operators.khanani_altaf: Global distribution network, hawala integration, FICN placement into formal economy
key_operators.khanani_javed: India-facing operations, border logistics, coordination with sleeper cells
key_operators.major_iqbal: ISI liaison for operational funding allocation, strategic targeting decisions
key_operators.bade_sahab: Institutional protection, conflict resolution between network partners

timeline_key_events.ficn_significance: Establishes D-Company capability for coordinated large-scale operations
RBI and IB identify systematic high-quality counterfeiting operation
Confirms ISI-D-Company joint operations including currency warfare
Kinetic financial strike — ₹500 and ₹1000 notes demonetised overnight
26 days post-demonetisation; circumstances disputed — natural, assassinated, or suicide

detection_mechanisms.effectiveness: Demonetisation achieved >80% FICN value destruction overnight; new ₹500/2000 notes with different security features forced network restart

film_relevance.dhurandhar_2_climax: Demonetisation as financial warfare — direct strike on adversary funding
film_relevance.operational_significance: Without FICN network, adversary operations face traceability; Indian response forces adaptation to less efficient funding
